title: Machine fault sensors (synthetic)
description: 400 machines, 8 sensor readings, predict whether a fault occurred. On the usual 80/20 split Random Forest looks clearly better. Chosen because it shows split sensitivity: watch what happens on other splits.

suggested_claim.source_note: Illustrative claim written for this example; it is not taken from a published paper.

provenance_note: Synthetic data from scikit-learn's make_classification, selected from generated candidates because the claim holds on the default split but not on most others (scripts/make_demo_fixture.py; search recorded in sensor_fault_synthetic.provenance.json). Does not describe real machines.

title: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
description: 569 tumors described by 30 numeric measurements. A public teaching dataset where a linear model is known to do well, which makes it a fair test of a claim that Random Forest is clearly better.

suggested_claim.source_note: Illustrative claim written for this example; it is not taken from a published paper.

provenance_note: Exported unmodified from scikit-learn's load_breast_cancer (UCI Machine Learning Repository). Not for clinical use.
